scope: 2025-edition SOI ABDB products and their derivatives only; does not alter other source licences

categories.repository_handling: retain locally; no public distribution; existing read-only research continues within user scope
categories.evidence: Pricing page describes conditional Digital Licence internal use for open-series products; no executed ABDB licence or specific unconditional research grant was established.
Copyright policy requires written permission for reproduction; ABDB download listing and public catalogue classification supply access, not an express redistribution grant.
No inspected ABDB term expressly grants public redistribution of transformed or reprojected geometry.
Publishing Licence template defines a limited, read-only raster publication scope (definitions and clause 3.2); signing, payment and licence issuance are conditions, not automatic permission.
No inspected official term expressly addresses district rainfall aggregates computed using ABDB polygons. This is uncertainty, not a finding that such aggregates are legally prohibited.

categories.repository_handling: allow only original project code, schemas, factual source references/identity metadata, checksums and redacted provenance; no source policy documents, geometry, observations or numerical rainfall statistics
categories.evidence: Continues the explicitly reviewed repository scope; does not assert a blanket SOI grant to reproduce its material.

source_attribution: Survey of India, Government of India

bundled_metadata.B56_other_constraints: Geospatial Guidelines 2021 to be followed; violations subject to applicable laws
bundled_metadata.embedded_qgis_metadata: empty descriptive/legal fields; no additional grant
bundled_metadata.archive_inventory: shapefile components and QGIS/XML metadata only; no separate redistribution licence file observed

applicability_limits: No executed publishing/digital licence or written permission is recorded.
The publishing template and pricing page do not establish an unconditional licence for the downloaded 1:50000 ABDB edition.
SOI superseded-policies page lists National Map Policy 2005 and implementation guidelines; older publication controls are not assumed to be current ABDB obligations.

Vector catalogue 2025 was inspected through the web reader (Karnataka 31 districts, ABDB classified public); full local PDF retention stopped at the 2 MiB ceiling. No complete response checksum is claimed.
Website terms advise checking ambiguities with the department; this register is evidence-based repository handling, not a legal determination.
